const docs = [
  ['01 Shipping Policy', 'Orders leave our US warehouse within 1 to 2 business days. Delivery takes 3 to 7 business days after dispatch. Shipping is free over $40 and $5.95 below that. We ship within the United States only. A tracking link is emailed at dispatch.'],
  ['02 Returns and Refunds', 'Unopened tins can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a refund to the original payment method. Opened tins cannot be returned. If a tin arrives damaged or wrong, email a photo within 7 days for a replacement or refund. Customers pay return shipping unless we sent the wrong item or it arrived damaged. Refunds take 5 to 10 business days to show.'],
  ['03 Subscription Management', 'Subscriptions renew monthly on the signup date. From the account page a customer can pause, skip a month, change the blend or cancel, at least 48 hours before the next renewal. Cancelling stops future charges. Shipments already dispatched are not refunded.'],
  ['04 Order Tracking', 'A tracking link is emailed when the order ships. If nothing arrives within 3 business days, check spam, then email support with the order number. Support cannot see live carrier updates, and the tracking link always has the latest status.'],
  ['05 Brewing Guide', 'Green and sencha: 75 to 80 C water, 1 to 3 minutes. Oolong: 85 to 95 C, 2 to 4 minutes. Black: 95 to 100 C, 3 to 5 minutes. Herbal: 100 C, 5 to 7 minutes. Use about one teaspoon per cup.'],
  ['06 Ingredients and Allergens', 'Full ingredient lists are on each product page. Support cannot give allergy or medical advice by email. Allergy questions are answered by a team member.'],
  ['07 Billing and Payment', 'Cards are charged at the time of order. Subscriptions are charged on the renewal date. A failed payment is retried once after 3 days and the customer is emailed. Receipts are emailed after every charge.'],
  ['08 Contact and Hours', 'Support is email only, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Eastern. We reply within 1 business day.']
];
return docs.map(d => ({ json: { title: d[0], source: 'brightleaf-kb', text: d[0] + '. ' + d[1] } }));
